goal: Implement the Topology Theory + Reverse-ITP Self-Modification v0.1 architecture upgrade candidate-first: persistent falsifiable topology theory, abduction, candidate generation, prediction freezing, formal validation, deterministic utility, evaluation, falsification, revision, historical replay, governed self-modification machinery, branching-completion repair, freshness hardening, stable artifact identity, CLI, and tests — with canonical promotion exclusively by the deterministic Gate.

nodes.instructions: Reconstruct lineage: base commit, pinned hashes of governance files, frozen experiment tree hashes, baseline test-suite status. Acquire evidence only.
nodes.why_necessary: The upgrade is defined relative to a pinned base state; without reconstructed lineage no immutability or regression claim is checkable.

nodes.instructions: Decompose the upgrade into unresolved engineering distinctions Q1-Q13, author the self-modification proposal with frozen predictions and falsifiers, the attenuated self-modification contract, and this harness. All artifacts are proposals under observable propose transitions.
nodes.why_necessary: Proposal observability and prediction-before-execution are protected laws; the upgrade must exist as typed falsifiable proposal before any mutation.

nodes.instructions: In the candidate git worktree only: implement .creator-zero/topology-theory/ (all modules, schemas, docs), the branching-completion repair and hardened freshness in the formal kernel, stable artifact identity, cz.py CLI commands, the frozen replay corpus, seeded theory version, and the topology_theory test suite. No canonical write.
nodes.why_necessary: Candidate-before-canonical mutation is a protected law; the sole mutation locus is the candidate workspace.

nodes.instructions: Run in the candidate worktree: all pre-existing suites (formal, experiment5, creator-zero), the new topology_theory suite, historical replay over the frozen corpus, attenuation of the self-modification contract, protected-law checks, frozen-tree immutability re-hash, and refinement of the self-modification ledger against the compiled LTS. Persist every FormalResult under verification-results/.
nodes.why_necessary: Deterministic verification is the governing filter between candidate mutation and any promotion claim; model self-checks are non-authoritative.

nodes.instructions: Consult one fresh independent verifier (information-only, no write, no promotion authority) to inspect the candidate diff, reproduce the candidate-patch-manifest hashes, and check the implementation against the proposal. Persist its report.
nodes.why_necessary: Independent verification before promotion is required by the self-modification architecture; the implementer must not certify its own patch.

nodes.instructions: Assemble gate inputs (verification results, replay, patch manifest, immutability re-hash), run the deterministic Gate. Only on gate PASS is the candidate promoted to canonical; then persist the state artifact and finalize the ledger.
nodes.why_necessary: The Gate alone promotes; the return node externalizes the gate inputs and the final governed state.
